decision.explanation: The original sources (D1S3 and D2S3) each assert that either Joe Biden or Donald Trump 'wins election to be the 46th US President' in the context of the 2020 US Presidential Election. Both claims are explicitly made within the same scope and refer to the same office (46th US President). These are conflicting assertions about the same referent (the winner of the 2020 US Presidential Election), and both are supported by direct quotes from separate documents. The audit confirms this conflict but does not resolve it definitively. Therefore, both answers remain valid until further authoritative resolution.
